Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers 6Li solid-state NMR to directly visualize lithium environments in paramagnetic LiFeCl3 cathodes, revealing hidden Li/Fe disorder, reversible intercalation-conversion chemistry, and trace Fe0 degradation. This enables optimized voltage windows achieving 85.9% retention over 500 cycles, establishing lithium-resolved NMR as a powerful platform linking disorder, hidden redox, and reversibility in all-solid-state batteries.

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a rotation-coupled guest-anion strategy using Mg(OTf)₂ in a PVDF-HFP solid electrolyte, where OTf⁻ acts as a mobile rotator synchronized with Na⁺ hopping. It lowers migration barriers, stabilizes the Na interface, and enables long-cycling solid-state sodium batteries. Screening 20 systems, it identifies anion symmetry and rotational barriers as design criteria.

item.title: Crystallography‐Dependent Plating/Stripping Kinetics and Interfacial Morphologies in Zn Metal Anodes
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work uniquely quantifies facet-dependent Zn plating/stripping kinetics using scanning electrochemical cell microscopy, revealing j0(100) > j0(101) > j0(002). It establishes a kinetics–stability trade-off: despite slower charge transfer, the (002) facet yields longest cycling life and best full-cell retention. This links crystallographic control of charge transfer, dissolution topology, and reconstruction to durable Zn anode design.
🏷 Zn metal anode · crystallographic orientation · plating/stripping kinetics · interfacial morphology · SECCM

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers entropy-engineered topological relaxor states in lead-free Na0.5Bi0.5TiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices, overcoming the polarization-dilution bottleneck of conventional ferroelectric/paraelectric designs.
